MEMORIES, NOT A MARKETPLACE

A ritual for
your community.

JOIN IN

Make the moment.

Three distinct chat participants send !moment. Everyone helps unlock the same chapter. Payments never affect progress.

KEEP IT

A memory with a name.

When a chapter unlocks, use !claim. Each account gets one copy of the chapter’s card. No random odds. Rarity describes the story, not a price.

COME BACK

There’s another chapter.

The creator opens each chapter at a natural stream break. Use !claim first-light to collect a previous unlocked chapter. No streaks, expiry timers or penalties for leaving.

Prototype, clearly labelled.

NOVA is an original adult anthropomorphic cat character drawn in SVG. The card artwork is animated illustration, not recorded stream footage. This is an independent prototype, not an official Twitch Drops campaign. The hosted preview simulates chat. The included local bridge implements Twitch OAuth and EventSub; it needs your registered app and a live account test.

No payments, Bits, subscriptions, Channel Points, wagering, trading, cash value or paid chances. No claim that this prototype has been approved by Twitch.

CONNECT THE REAL CHAT

Your channel.
Your lore.

This hosted preview is in demo mode. To connect Twitch, run the included local bridge with Node.js 22+ and register your app in Twitch Developer Console.

npm start → http://localhost:8787

The local version provides a Twitch login button. It requests read access to your chat only. It never asks you to paste a token into this preview.
